project_info.theme: Toyota Camry HEV makes family journeys feel shorter and more relaxing
project_info.color_palette: Warm sunset gold, silver gray, cool cyan, beige, deep green

main_subject.detail: A top-down cinematic poster of a silver Toyota Camry HEV parked or moving slowly on a sunlit road, with the car roof rendered transparent in a glowing cyan cutaway effect. Inside, a family sits comfortably: driver at the wheel, front passenger, a child in a rear child seat, plus luggage including a woven suitcase, cooler box, rolled mat, and teddy bear. Bottom-left text reads 'TOYOTA CAMRY HEV' and 'DUONG XA HOA NGAN THU THAI HANH TRINH'. Small note says '*Hinh anh duoc tao boi AI nham muc dich minh hoa'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Premium lifestyle automotive poster with semi-xray cabin visualization, calm family storytelling, and cinematic overhead composition

Background is a sunlit road bordered by trees with dramatic long shadows and warm golden-hour light. Technical style: photoreal automotive lifestyle composite with transparent cutaway effect, golden-hour cinematic automotive lighting, sun flare and cyan interior glow, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
